name: @mercatus-liber/adapter-clerk
description: AdminAuthAdapter (subsystem 21) backed by Clerk's real Next.js + Backend SDKs. Proves admin-auth is genuinely swappable, same as adapter-sanity proved for CMS persistence. Public surface is exactly AdminAuthAdapter; depends on @mercatus-liber/admin-auth only for the types it implements, plus @clerk/nextjs as the real identity provider it wraps. Role assignment lives entirely in Clerk's own publicMetadata -- this package owns no user store of its own.
